sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/atlanta.json: WORKED. 47 maps results and 26 web results. The web results had only google.com/goto redirect URLs with no domains, so I couldn't use them. I opened the plausible maps websites. Partitions Inc (partitionsgc.com) is a commercial GC and restoration firm with no toilet partition work shown, so I left it out. JSC Ltd. Co. is a handyman with no partition work. Atlanta Sunbelt Products (Winder) is a manufacturer and its site returned 503. The rest were remodelers, glass shops and stores.

Scranton Products Where to Buy (https://www.scrantonproducts.com/where-to-buy/): WORKED. The only GA entry is a sales rep agency, Southern States Architectural Sales (678.425.8796), with no installer or dealer listed.
Hadrian where-to-buy, Metpar find-a-rep, General Partitions representatives: all returned 404 at the URLs I tried.

Bobrick, ASI/Global Partitions, Bradley, Ampco/Ammco locators: not tried this run. An earlier run found Bobrick's locator unreadable and asipartitions.com/globalpartitions.com outside the allowed network domains.

The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): BLOCKED, every iProView page returned 403. Search snippets showed Division 10 Specialties South (Trion, GA, about 80 miles away, outside the radius) and Partition Plus Inc (location unknown).
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not reached, because no profiles came up in search and the search cap was hit.

WebSearch: used all 8 of 8 allowed searches. They covered toilet partition installation Atlanta, Division 10 contractor Atlanta, Blue Book Atlanta, suburb-name queries, the GA furnish-and-install query, Section 10 Inc Norcross, Terminus Specialties / Georgia Accessories, and Kennesaw/Lawrenceville/Duluth/Smyrna. These searches turned up Terminus Specialties, One Point Partitions and the BBB partition category.
BBB category page https://www.bbb.org/us/ga/chamblee/category/partition: WORKED. Only Georgia Accessories Inc (Tucker) looked relevant; no listing mentions toilet partitions.
phoenix-0af34b1.aws.mapquest.com: BLOCKED, the host is outside the session's allowed network domains. It has to be allowed in the session's network settings.
Skipped as out of scope: Prestige Distribution (Northbrook, IL, national installer network with no local base), UDH Group (NJ), and Division 10 Specialties South (Trion, GA, too far).

candidates.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists restroom partitions, partition hardware and repair kits with 'optional installation for all products'; contact page says it 'delivers expert installation and reliable service across partitions, doors, lockers, and safety products'.
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 supplier just south of Atlanta (McDonough, about 28 miles) that states it installs partitions for general contractors on commercial projects. No project photos of partitions seen, and it also sells partitions directly.
red_flags: Sells and supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
No partition project photos or brands seen
Email shown is a named person's address

license.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Georgia State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors (license verification at verify.sos.ga.gov); City of Atlanta business license (ATLBIZ) / Office of Buildings Accela portal
license.note: State lookup returned HTTP 403 to automated access (verify.sos.ga.gov and sos.ga.gov both 403 on 2026-11-19), so no state license record could be checked. Georgia's own rule for partition installers is still unclear (general contractor license over $2,500; possible specialty-contractor exemption not verified). City of Atlanta: no public business-license lookup found (business services moved to atlbiz.atlantaga.gov, which needs an account); the Office of Buildings Accela portal (aca-prod.accela.com/ATLANTA_GA/APO/APOLookup.aspx) offers 'Look Up by Licensed Professional' only through a postback search form, not checked. Company site lists restroom partitions with 'Optional installation for all products' and says it is based just south of Atlanta; no license number shown (https://www.terminusspecialties.com/). Confirm by phone with the state board and the City of Atlanta Office of Revenue.
